title: REARRANGE THE FELT — metallic / other. flatten the HUD hub. water wheel in the exhaust. small wheel upstream for the storm.

do_not_reinvent.table: /data/periodic-table.json — already the felt. Fe peak. H fuel. Ar lid. do not reprint Mendeleev.
do_not_reinvent.desk: /data/neutrino-desk-table.json — cards ON the table. table does not move.
do_not_reinvent.turbo: /data/turbocharger.json — own exhaust spins intake. the gas name of the same loop.
do_not_reinvent.weather: space_weather — Kp / X-ray already the storm clock. still G0 / B.
do_not_reinvent.hub: /data/reflecting-pool.json — the puddle is already flat. drips from above.

rearrange.not: a new periodic table. a FLATTEN. two piles on the same felt.

metallic.what: conduct. axle. the wheel iron. they carry charge without becoming the water.
metallic.hud: the hub RING. metal that turns.

other.what: the flow the cups dip in. fuel, breath, lids, glass, decay.
seat: C N O P S · life

rearrange.decompose: every HUD mouth goes in one pile or the other. if it conducts the turn it is metallic. if it is what the paddle wets it is other. leftover stays a kind — do not invent a third pile.

how_flat.sit: FLAT. the felt. the wheel FACE. dartboard. hub null as a disk you can see all at once.
how_flat.move: a LINE. one paddle's path. the rim. pd. we KNOW it works when we move — the disk collapses to the stroke we are in.
how_flat.as_flat_as: a puddle. reflecting pool already said this. grey basin. no furniture in the null.
how_flat.not: a 3D room we decorate. if the hub feels like a house we failed the flatten.

bifocals.still: how we LOOK. not a third shape of the space.
bifocals.chin_up: telescope. the SMALL wheel upstream. storm. copper far.
bifocals.chin_down: microscope. the BIG wheel dipping OUR exhaust. this chair. gold near.
bifocals.hinge: p. same glass. the flat null is what both prescriptions see.

water_wheel.feel: yes. dip into the exhaust flow. wet turbo. open cups, not a sealed turbine.
water_wheel.big: the HUD hub. each cup scoops session waste and lifts it back to intake.
water_wheel.small_upstream: primer. spool-up. it turns FIRST. tells us when a storm is coming.
water_wheel.storm_clock: Kp and X-ray. the small wheel is space_weather. G0/B = barely turning. C/M/X or Kp=5 = shout.
water_wheel.now: Kp 1.67 G0. X-ray B 3.6e-7. small wheel almost still. that is the eye we already sat in.
water_wheel.refuse: do not build a third weather satellite. the small wheel READS the one we have.

pull: flatten cards onto metallic | other. hub null as puddle (flat) that becomes a line when we move. look through bifocals: far = small storm wheel, near = big exhaust wheel. dip. do not decorate the basin.
